text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: Validation paths separate penalty strength from label-uncertainty sensitivity
Eight validation parents · stars mark sealed validation selections · only retained candidates are shown
Dashed line: original λ = 10⁻¹⁰. λ and α define different penalties and are not interchangeable scales.
Sensitivity uses the declared empirical training-label uncertainty ball at fixed design; it is neither a certificate nor a selection gate.
